description: "Extracts feature-level (peptide/transition) data for proteins of interest from DIA-NN output and generates visualizations of intensity distributions across replicates and conditions."
---

Extract feature-level data for specific proteins from DIA-NN, the MSstats.csv output, and graph the intensities.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --- SETUP: Load required libraries and define paths ---
library(arrow)
library(beeswarm)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(here)
library(Hmisc)
library(janitor)
library(pbapply)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

# --- LOAD CONFIGURATION ---
source(here::here("src", "config.R"))

# --- Define proteins to extract ---
extract_list <- c("TFRC", "PLXNA2", "TMX3", "FLT1", "LMAN2", "SLC44A2", "LDLR", "SIRPA", "HM13", "EZR", "VAPA", "ZYX", "TES", "ACSL1", "AKAP12", "BCAM", "MET", "TJP2", "ADAM9", "LAMP1", "RALA", "IL6ST", "MMP14", "SSR1", "BTN1A1", "CAPNS1", "CLIC4", "TEK", "CPNE1", "VASP", "CAPN1", "ANXA5", "TGM1", "SEPTIN2", "ITGB3", "CD59")

# --- Hardcoded Box paths (note: future work to centralize in src/config.R) ---
box_root <- "C:/Users/andbp/Box/Backus_Lab/Andrew_Becker/ABecker_Lab_Notebook/R_WD"
ref_dir  <- file.path(box_root, "Reference_dbs")
exp1_dir <- file.path(box_root, "AP2-339_HAECs_DF-UF_ALOD4_OLyA", "01_Input_Search_Results")
parquet_files <- file.path(box_root, "AP2-339_HAECs_DF-UF_ALOD4_OLyA", "02_R_Intermediates")
output_dir <- file.path(box_root, "AP2-339_HAECs_DF-UF_ALOD4_OLyA", "feature_extraction")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

```{r data_loading}
# --- DATA LOADING ---
# Read feature-level file, converting CSV to Parquet for efficient processing
# Note: CSV-to-Parquet pattern is a candidate for extraction to src/functions.R

# Define paths for the source CSV and the target Parquet file
csv_source <- file.path(exp1_dir, "339B-top4-features_feature-level-data_impute.csv")
pq_target  <- file.path(parquet_files, "339B-top4-features_feature-level-data_impute.parquet")

# Only convert if the parquet file doesn't already exist
if (!file.exists(pq_target)) {
  message("Parquet file not found. Reading CSV and converting... (This may take a moment)")
  temp_df <- arrow::read_csv_arrow(csv_source) 
  arrow::write_parquet(temp_df, pq_target)
  rm(temp_df)
  gc() 
  message("Conversion complete.")
} else {
  message("Parquet file found. Loading cached data.")
}

# Read the optimized Parquet file
exp1.features <- arrow::read_parquet(pq_target)

# Load UniProt accession <-> Gene mapping file and apply to features
# Note: UniProt lookup pattern is a candidate for extraction to src/functions.R
df.labels <- read_excel(file.path(ref_dir, "uniprot_hs_29may25.xlsx"))
lookup <- df.labels %>% select(ProteinID, Gene)
exp1.features <- exp1.features %>%
  left_join(lookup, by = c("PROTEIN" = "ProteinID")) %>%
  relocate(Gene, .after = PROTEIN)

# Verify the merge
head(exp1.features)
```

```{r data_cleaning}
# --- DATA CLEANING: Check matches/non-matches ---
matches <- extract_list[extract_list %in% exp1.features$Gene]
mismatches <- extract_list[!(extract_list %in% exp1.features$Gene)]

message("Matches found: ", length(unique(matches)))
print(unique(matches))

message("Genes not found: ", length(unique(mismatches)))
print(unique(mismatches))
```

```{r data_processing}
# --- DATA PROCESSING: Extract features for proteins of interest ---
# Clean the dataframe - remove empty column header if present (index artifact)
if (colnames(exp1.features)[1] == "" || is.na(colnames(exp1.features)[1])) {
  message("Detected empty column header (index artifact). Removing column 1.")
  exp1.features <- exp1.features[, -1] 
}

# Filter to proteins of interest
features_subset <- exp1.features %>% 
  filter(Gene %in% extract_list)

# Validation
if (nrow(features_subset) == 0) {
  warning("No rows returned. Check if gene names supplied match the casing in your 'Gene' column exactly.")
} else {
  message(paste("Success! Extracted", nrow(features_subset), "rows for:", paste(extract_list, collapse=", ")))
  print(head(features_subset))
}
```

```{r visualization}
# --- VISUALIZATION: Generate bar plots per gene (all replicates) ---
source(here::here("src", "DIA_feature_extract_barplots.R")) 
batch_plot_genes(extract_list, exp1.features, output_dir)
```

```{r visualization_by_group}
# --- VISUALIZATION: Generate bar plots per gene (stratified by group) ---
source(here::here("src", "DIA_feature_extract_barplots_by_group.R")) 
batch_plot_genes_by_group(extract_list, exp1.features, output_dir)
```
